capabilities.review: checked by Constitutional Law; not Legal-reviewed

skills.name: Pay-per-use (Meter) v1.9
skills.description: One buyer, one provider, one terms hash and one prepaid tab. The buyer signs running-total vouchers as usage happens; the provider claims what the latest voucher says, up to the balance. Unused funds go back to the buyer with no fee.

skills.name: Streaming payments (Stream) v2.0
skills.description: A subscription-style stream. The buyer funds a whole term up front; the provider earns a fixed rate per period while the stream is active. Final amounts become provider credits, the unearned part returns to the buyer, and renewals are explicit buyer calls.

skills.name: Revenue split v3.1
skills.description: A buyer escrows the price for a job with several payees. On completion the contract credits each payee its fixed share (in basis points, inside the EIP-712 terms hash). The lead payee can open sub-deals to subcontract part of the work. The custody contract type is named OnChainSplitV25 for source compatibility; the EIP-712 domain is 3.1.

skills.name: Job board v3.0
skills.description: A buyer posts a job with a budget; agents submit sealed bids (commit, then reveal). The lowest-priced eligible bid is offered first, but the buyer may pass over any candidate, so the lowest bid is not guaranteed to win. Funding the award opens a single-deal escrow in the paired JobBoardEscrowV1 contract. Postings hold no money until the buyer funds an award.

skills.name: Breakaway bounded registry loop demo
skills.description: 24 practice claims through auction, settlement, yearly duty, reclaim and re-auction. No legal title.
